description: Election Commission - Presidential Election - 2024, Appoint the Returning Officers for Electoral District
categorisation: This gazette content specifically concerns the appointment of Returning Officers for the presidential election under the Presidential Elections Act. It involves electoral processes and the Election Commission's actions related to election administration, which falls squarely under the Elections category (Type 7). While it mentions individuals (commission members), this is incidental to the primary electoral function rather than constituting a government personnel appointment gazette.
